task.title: PR work row, signed actions, PR-bound sessions, /review and Create Flow from session
task.description: Plan slice 4. (a) Work row: on every PR card (ReviewResults board tile) and list row render a Keryx work row with exactly three slots in fixed order review | Flow | session, same DOM structure when empty or filled, fixed height in apps/desktop/src/styles/review.css (height, not min-height; text truncates). Review slot: when card.localReview has state, a link-button with text "Review · <state>" from localReview (queued, running, needs your answer, ready, partial, publication pending, failed/stopped, outdated via reviewNote) with NO round number and NO behind count; click calls the existing openReview(card) (current review panel). Empty: labelled action "Run review" -> openReview. CardReviewProgress may move into or under the row but must not change the row height. Flow slot: flows for the PR = flows whose prUrl matches card.url (existing match in ReviewBoard) UNION flows whose dir equals sessionFlags(session).flow for a non-archived session whose subject is this PR (sameSubject from apps/desktop/src/acp/types.ts); text "Flow #<id> · <stage>" (stage label from flows/model laneOf or status) -> onOpenFlow(dir); empty: "Create Flow" action. Session slot: non-archived sessions with subject matching the PR (kind pr, repo = snapshot.repo, number); text "Session" or "<n> sessions" opens the newest; a small adjacent menu button (labelled, aria-haspopup=menu) lists the sessions by title and "New session"; empty: "Open in session". (b) Signed actions: every card/list action control has visible text (Open on GitHub, Subscribe/Following); remove the icon-only ReviewAction buttons that the row replaces. Do not add "Fix review comments". (c) Props: ReviewBoard gets sessions (SessionInfo[]) and callbacks onOpenSubjectSession(card, target: "latest"|"new"|sessionId) and onCreateFlow(card); keep onOpenSession compat only if still used. (d) App.tsx + useAcpSession.ts: subject binding like pendingFlow/applyPendingFlow: a new session gets pending subject {kind:"pr", repo, number, url, repositoryId} sent through _keryx/session_flags (SESSION_FLAGS) with subject; retried after first turn like pendingFlow; if keryx replies without subject (older keryx) show a notice via s.notify("warn"|...) that the binding was not saved, but still open the session. Open in session: latest -> loadSession newest non-archived bound session; none or "new" -> new session + pending subject + prefill composer with PR URL (fillComposer; never send). Keep linking to an existing Flow that has this prUrl (as today) as well. (e) Session header: when the shown session has a subject, AppShell title area shows a link-button "PR owner/repo#N" (or "Issue owner/repo#N") that returns to the card: PR -> switch to review view and open that PR detail panel (add a ReviewBoard prop like focus={number, nonce} that sets selected); Issue -> existing openIssueOrigin({sessionId}). Also show a "Flow #id" link when the session has a flow flag (opens Flow). (f) /review: when draftReview.target is empty and the draft session has a PR subject, pass the subject URL as initialTarget to ReviewLaunchDialog. The run it starts already reaches the board via publishSessionReview/subscribeSessionReview: verify the card review slot updates (test). (g) Create Flow: opens the PR-bound session (latest or new) and prefills the composer with a flow prompt naming the PR URL, e.g. "Create a Keryx flow for <url> with flow-orchestrator."; record a pending flow-link {sessionId, knownDirs:set of current flow dirs}; when flows.cards later contains exactly one dir not in knownDirs and the session has no flow flag, link it via the existing session_flags flow path and clear the pending entry; when several new dirs appear, link none and clear. (h) Tests: DOM tests in src/review for the row (structure same at 0 and 3 links, labels, click targets, no round/behind text), signed actions (every action control has non-empty text), session slot menu; App-level or hook-level tests for subject binding (open twice -> same session, new session, older keryx notice), /review preselect, Create Flow linking (one new dir links, two do not). Find existing App/useAcpSession tests with keryx ctx rg and follow their harness. Do not touch the attention set in ReviewBoard.tsx (carriedAttention, seeded, seedFor, attentionPrs, stale, needsViewerAttention); list any line you must edit. Do not add elements to .flows-toolbar.

acceptance_criteria: AC5: Every PR card and list row renders a Keryx work row with exactly three slots (review, Flow, session) whose DOM structure is the same with zero and with three links, and the row has a fixed height in `apps/desktop/src/styles/review.css`; the review slot shows the state from `localReview` without a round number or behind count and opens the current review panel; the Flow slot shows "Flow #<id> · <stage>" and opens the Flow; empty slots show the labelled actions "Run review", "Create Flow", "Open in session" (R4 part, R7, spec AC14) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review`]

AC6: Every action on a PR card, PR list row and Issue card has a visible text label (a DOM test asserts non-empty text content for each action control); "Fix review comments" is not shown in this stage (R7 part, spec AC15 part) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review src/issues`]

AC7: "Open in session" on a PR with no bound session creates a new session bound to the PR Subject and prefills the composer with the PR URL without sending it; pressing it again opens the same session (newest non-archived bound session); the session slot menu lists the bound sessions and "New session", which creates another bound session (R5, spec AC8 part) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]

AC8: Subject storage: `_keryx/session_flags` accepts `subject` {kind "pr"|"issue", repo, number, url}, refuses an invalid one, persists it in `flags.json` so a fresh read (restart) returns it, and `null` unlinks it; an Issue session bound by `withIssueBinding` carries `subject.kind = "issue"`; when keryx replies without `subject`, Desktop still opens the session and shows a notice that the binding was not saved (spec AC8, failure scenario) [verify: exec `bun test src/session/organize.test.ts src/acp/shell-session-organize.test.ts src/session/issues`]

AC9: "Create Flow" on a PR card opens the PR-bound session with a prefilled flow prompt naming the PR URL; the first new flow package that appears while that request is pending is linked to the session (`flow` flag) and shown as the Flow link on that PR card; when several new packages appear, none is linked automatically (R6) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]

AC10: In a PR-bound session, `/review` without a target opens the launch dialog with that PR preselected, and the review started there appears as the review link on that PR card without a manual refresh (R6, spec AC9) [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src`]

AC14: The Pull requests tab attention set and indicator are preserved: `ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx` passes, and every edited line in `carriedAttention`, `seeded`, `seedFor`, `attentionPrs` or `stale` handling has a recorded one-line mutation that fails a test (journal) · sensitive: mutation [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/review/ReviewBoard.dom.test.tsx`]

AC17: The Pull requests toolbar keeps the stage 0 behaviour: no element added to `.flows-toolbar`, or, if one is added, the board toolbar is re-measured at the stage 0 widths and the result recorded in the journal [verify: judged]
